name: @ndp-software/component-bwilder
description: Typed web-component builder with render lifecycle helpers

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:js && npm run build:types
scripts.dev: npm run clean && concurrently 'npm run build:types -- --watch' 'npm run build:js -- --watch' 'npm run typecheck -- --watch' 'npm run test:watch'
